title: Kimi Code Sessions
description: Settings for the Kimi Code sessions side panel.

presentationMode.title: Presentation mode
presentationMode.description: How session rows are labelled. `name` (default) shows the session title Kimi records for the project (a custom title shows through); the initial name is taken from the project folder name, then the path is walked up to disambiguate when two projects share a folder name. `path` shows the project path relative to the JupyterLab notebook root (absolute if outside it).

recentLimit.title: Recent items count
recentLimit.description: Number of sessions listed in the Recent section, sorted by last activity (descending). The section displays up to 10 rows and scrolls for the rest.

yoloMode.title: YOLO mode
yoloMode.description: When enabled, newly spawned and resumed sessions are launched with `--yolo`. Kimi auto-approves regular tool calls without asking - only enable in workspaces you trust.

colouredTabs.title: Coloured terminal tabs
colouredTabs.description: When enabled (default), a terminal running Kimi has its dock tab tinted with a colour derived deterministically from that conversation's session id (Kimi has no `/color` command, so the tint is stable per conversation instead of user-set). Turning it off clears the tint from Kimi terminals and stops it being applied. Requires `jupyterlab_colourful_tab_extension`; without it there is no tint either way.

sidebar.title: Sidebar position
sidebar.description: Which JupyterLab sidebar to dock the panel to. `right` (default) keeps it clear of the file browser. `left` puts it next to the file browser. Takes effect immediately.
